units.claim: The domain layer holds the entities/models and use-case interfaces under src/domain.
The application layer holds use cases, ports, errors and validations under src/application.
The presentation (interface adapters) layer holds controllers, middlewares and responses under src/presentation.
The infrastructure layer holds express, knex and repository implementations under src/infrastructure.
The main layer is the composition root with factories under src/main, allowed to depend on all other layers.

citations.quote: It may depend on all other layers in the system.

units.claim: Layers are ordered domain, application, presentation, infrastructure, main, from innermost to outermost, with dependencies pointing only inward.

citations.quote: The overriding rule that makes this architecture work is The Dependency Rule.
